changes.oldText: The personal Sessions page shows only the sessions of the project selected with the project selector in the top bar — its address is /project/<project name>/session — and it always shows only your own sessions, regardless of your role. To view and manage sessions across all users in a project, use the Sessions page under Admin Settings in the sidebar.
